name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Carbon Accounting for Claude Code: what needs a person, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Customer deadlines, suppliers who have not replied, missing bills and compliance items.
sections.sql: select what, item, detail from carbon.attention order by sort_on, what, item

sections.title: Missing months
sections.sql: select source, site, month, data_owner as ask from carbon.data_gaps order by source, month

sections.title: Customer requests
sections.sql: select customer, inventory, asked_for, due_on, days_left from (select cr.customer, i.name as inventory, cr.asked_for, cr.due_on, cr.due_on - current_date as days_left, cr.answered_on from carbon.customer_requests cr left join carbon.inventories i on i.id = cr.inventory_id) x where answered_on is null order by due_on nulls last

name: footprint
title: Footprint
subtitle: Every year side by side, the biggest sources this year, and progress on the target

sections.title: By year
sections.sql: select inventory as year, status, scope1_t as scope_1, scope2_t as scope_2, scope3_t as scope_3, total_t as total, case when months_elapsed < months_total then months_elapsed || ' of ' || months_total || ' months' else 'full year' end as covers from carbon.inventory_totals order by starts_on

sections.title: Biggest sources this year
sections.sql: select source, site, scope, round(tco2e, 1) as tco2e from carbon.inventory_sources s join carbon.inventories i on i.id = s.inventory_id where i.status = 'open' order by tco2e desc limit 10

sections.title: Reduction actions
sections.sql: select a.name as action, st.name as site, a.owner, a.status, a.saving_tco2e_per_year as saving_t_per_year, a.due_on from carbon.actions a left join carbon.sites st on st.id = a.site_id where a.status <> 'dropped' order by a.status, a.due_on

sections.title: Compliance
sections.sql: select severity, rule, coalesce(item, inventory) as item, finding from carbon.compliance_findings order by severity, rule
